title: Pearlmoor Quay - Moonlit Quay Waltz
_note: Anchor. gbc 4-voice, no chords. 100 BPM, 3/4, F major. Accordion-flavoured lilting WALTZ - the Vesper contour reshaped to swing on the downbeat-and-lift of 3/4 (lift lands on the bar downbeat, settle sways over beats 2-3). Carries the Tinderwick lullaby DNA as a 3/4 waltz. Tide signature fully foregrounded. Harmony = Tide bell-buoy chimes on beats 2&3 (oom-pah-pah upper voice). Bass = classic waltz - root on 1, rocking fifths on 2&3, like a moored hull. Percussion = soft noise brush only on beat 1, the boardwalk creak. 24-bar loop ~43s.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Vesper as a waltz in F: lift C4->F4->G4 lands on downbeats, settle A4->G4->F4 sways over 2-3. AABA-leaning across 24 bars; D-minor (relative) lean in B section. Final bar leans on C (V) into bar 1.

tracks._note: Tide bell-buoy chimes on beats 2&3 (the 'pah-pah'). Rest on beat 1 (bass owns it). Broken-triad upper notes: F(A-C), C(C-E), Dm(F-A), Bb(D-F), Gm(D-G), Am(C-E) following the changes.
